spec.name: Orange Kitchen Rice
spec.description: A harvested sheaf of rice with slender green-gold stalks, curling blade leaves and three drooping panicles of plump, elongated golden husks. Ivory grain highlights and a straw binding keep the silhouette readable as a warm vanilla kitchen ingredient. Stalk ends rest at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Rice. Recognizable harvested produce matching the exact species; natural stepped silhouette and species-specific skin/leaf detail.
